problem.title: Sum of Array
problem.statement: Given an integer array arr[], return the sum of all elements of arr.

python3.initialCode:
# Driver code
if __name__ == "__main__":
    tc = int(input())
    while tc > 0:
        arr = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))
        ob = Solution()
        ans = ob.arraySum(arr)
        print(ans)
        tc = tc - 1
        print("~")
